fields.Name: T11 - Run a Saved Query
fields.Description: Runs a saved query that has no required parameters and verifies tabular results.

InputDefinition.goal: Run a saved query and view its results. In the LEFT sidebar 'Search queries...' box (NOT the global Ctrl+K box), type 'Entities with Field Counts' and select that query. If it is not present, pick any other query that shows NO required-parameter asterisks (e.g. 'Server Installed Version History'). AVOID queries marked 'Pending' or showing required-parameter asterisks. Click Run and verify results display in a table with data rows. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A no-parameter Approved query was located (via the 'Search queries...' box or a visible folder) and run
Query results are displayed in a table with data rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
